L4-0639.note: N. "bard" led the card out of CC-CEDICT; it is not the word a learner needs.

L4-0703.note: N. "gymnastic" is the adjective and led a noun card.

L4-0805.note: N. "image" led the card; 拍照 L4-0545 already carries "to photograph".

L4-0883.note: V. The L4 sense is importing technology or people; 进口 L4-0410 owns "to import" for goods.

L5-0179.note: Adj. "cowardice" is a noun and led an adjective card.

L5-0556.note: N. A 频道 is a broadcast channel; 频率 L5-0555 is frequency.

L5-0562.note: N. "field" led the card; a 平原 is a plain.
